[[File:Kasukarp.png|thumb|250px|Kasukarp]] '''Kasukarp''' (Japanese: '''カスキング''' ''Kasuking'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN026|Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown!]]''. In addition to being a ten-time winner of the annual [[Magikarp High Jump Competition]], he is also a {{wp|personal trainer}}. Kasukarp competed in the tenth annual Magikarp High Jump Competition using his {{Shiny}} {{p|Magikarp}}, where it went up against [[Goh]] and his giant Magikarp. Kasukarp was ultimately declared the winner when [[Goh's giant Magikarp|Goh's own Magikarp]] jumped so high that it went into space and didn't land in time. Kasukarp later visited {{TRT}}'s base, only for [[James]] to shut the door on him. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kasukarp |pkmn=Magikarp |nick=Shinegoldie |shiny=yes |type1=Water |img=Kasukarp Shinegoldie.png |epnum=JN026 |epname=Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown! |vajp= |vaen= |desc='''Shinegoldie''' (Japanese: '''キンキング''' ''Kinking''), a {{Shiny}} {{p|Magikarp}}, was used to compete in the tenth annual [[Magikarp High Jump Competition]]. It was ultimately declared the winner when [[Goh's giant Magikarp]] failed to land in time. Shinegoldie's only known move is {{m|Splash}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kasukarp |pkmn=Machamp |nick=Machamp (×2) |type1=Fighting |img=Kasukarp Machamp.png |epnum=JN026 |epname=Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown! |vajp= |vaen= |desc=Kasukarp has two {{p|Machamp}} that he uses to help train his Magikarp for the [[Magikarp High Jump Competition]].
